en: The image is a colorized vintage postcard showing an electric tram on a tall, arched bridge. On the left, there are trees, while in the distance is a wide landscape view with water and green fields on the right. There is a sign in Dutch and text printed in the upper left corner that reads 'Mooi Nederland, Nijmegen.' The tram runs under overhead electrical wires supported by lattice towers.
